causal_chain: observed repeated opaque rc255 -> missing SOCKS protocol stage receipts -> project-private byte-transparent relay sidecar -> remove blind handshake/graph retry -> verify stage receipt bound to nonce and unchanged SSH stream
challenged_assumption: OpenSSH -vv plus nc failure text is enough to localize the transport boundary; v4 contradicts this.
direction: Remote route observability and invalid handshake cost; distinct from EVO44 suffix and EVO43 SDK

discarded_action.action: Repeat an opaque nc-backed SSH probe from the same route and infer cause from rc255 or the client version line.
discarded_action.causal_reason: nc obscures SOCKS5 stage responses, while OpenSSH debug logs only its side of the stream.
discarded_action.observed_failure: v4 rc255 with no server banner and no authenticated remote result.

inferences: Opaque nc ProxyCommand hides a failure boundary that matters before choosing another route or expensive graph release.
The closing component is unknown; v4 does not prove gz02 host state or the proxy cause.
observations: Signal v2 had all four host-static phases rc0; no startup or device result.
G279 v4 root accepted terminal rc255, graph commands 0, no server banner, host key or authentication observed.
OpenKeychain v2 host-static rc0 with signature verification not proven and no startup.
v4 stderr contains client local version and kex close but no SOCKS5 method or CONNECT response bytes.

one_improvement.candidate: For a future independently released, project-private read-only handshake, replace opaque nc ProxyCommand with a byte-transparent SOCKS5 relay that emits a sidecar stage receipt (method reply, CONNECT reply code, first server banner presence) keyed to fresh nonce and exact target; preserve existing SSH host-key pin and no-replay gate.
one_improvement.failure_behavior: Fail closed on malformed/partial SOCKS replies or timeout, stop before remote command; record stage UNKNOWN when bytes absent; do not infer remote failure from rc255 alone.
one_improvement.invalidation: Discard receipt if target, proxy endpoint, source SHA, nonce, or host-key pin changes; no reuse of v4 nonce or receipt.
one_improvement.key: fresh nonce + target host/port + local SOCKS endpoint + wrapper source SHA + SSH host-key pin + route policy
one_improvement.mechanism: Locates first failing transport stage from protocol replies in the same authorized connection; prevents ambiguous rc255 from prompting another blind graph or duplicate route attempt.
one_improvement.pilot_result: Six offline SOCKS5 stage fixtures classified as expected; historical v4 receipt remains SOCKS_METHOD_UNKNOWN despite ssh rc255. This validates only proposed receipt classification, not relay implementation or live route.
one_improvement.promotion_gate: Implement a fresh isolated wrapper candidate and offline socketpair fixtures for fragmented replies, byte preservation, close/timeout and no payload logging; independently review route/host-key/nonce/no-replay controls before one new read-only release. Promote only if same attempt yields unambiguous protocol-stage receipt; never claim authenticated remote or graph until separate receipts prove them.
one_improvement.risk: A custom relay could alter bytes or leak credentials/remote data; require binary-transparent fixture proof, bounded sanitized stage metadata only, no payload capture, timeout and independent peer review.
one_improvement.scope: Host transport diagnostics only. No SSH run was made in EVO45; no build graph, device, bridge or startup evidence.

problem: Released G279 v4 read-only identity probe ended ssh rc255 before observed server banner; existing OpenSSH/nc receipts cannot locate whether SOCKS greeting, SOCKS CONNECT, or upstream SSH stream failed.
unknowns: Whether local SOCKS5 accepted method negotiation or CONNECT.
Whether gz02 emitted any server bytes on that attempt.
Whether a different route would work.
